en:
## New Features

- Added an application-level VNet relay with WebSocket, UDP rendezvous, encrypted packet helpers, status API, and runtime settings.
- Added per-narrator custom traits for restricting subagent model pools and disabling selected tools from the narrator details panel.
- Added a shared Learning Center and LearningGuide tool so users and agents can browse NarraFork workflows and product guidance.
- Unified custom AI provider configuration while keeping legacy provider settings compatible.
- Improved Codex quota forecasting and account selection, including weekly quota exhaustion handling.

## Bug Fixes

- Hardened VNet relay validation for oversized messages, duplicate virtual IPs, forged packet metadata, and reconnects in full networks.
- Made pending permission reprocessing safer so interrupted or delayed permissions can resume without inconsistent state.
- Strengthened benchmark execution with admin-only access, stricter suite validation, safer run cancellation, and more conservative SWE-bench scoring.
- Improved narrator execution safeguards around tool availability, subagent inheritance, compaction, image reuse, and review conclusion startup cycles.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增应用层 VNet Relay，支持 WebSocket、UDP rendezvous、加密包工具、状态 API 与运行时设置。
- 新增叙述者自定义 traits，可在叙述者详情面板限制 subagent 模型池并禁用指定工具。
- 新增共享 Learning Center 和 LearningGuide 工具，方便用户与 agent 查阅 NarraFork 工作流和产品指引。
- 统一自定义 AI Provider 配置，同时保持旧版 provider 设置兼容。
- 改进 Codex 配额预测和账号选择，支持识别周配额耗尽并自动避开不可用账号。

## 修复

- 加固 VNet Relay 校验，拦截超大消息、重复虚拟 IP、伪造包元数据，并支持满员网络中的同 peer 重连替换。
- 更安全地重新处理待决权限，避免中断或延迟权限恢复后出现状态不一致。
- 强化 Benchmark 执行：仅管理员可用、更严格的 suite 校验、更安全的运行取消，以及更保守的 SWE-bench 评分。
- 改进叙述者执行安全边界，覆盖工具可用性、subagent 继承、上下文压缩、图片复用和评审结论工具的启动循环问题。
